s.d: παρά-πτωρμα, -τος, τό (παραπίπτω), [in LXX for מַעַל, פֶּשַׁע, etc. ;] 1. a false step, a blunder (Polyb.). 2. Ethically, a misdeed, trespass (LXX): [[matthew 6 14|Mat.6:14-15]], [[mark 11 25|Mrk.11:25-26]], [[romans 4 25|Rom.4:25 5:15]] ff [[romans 11 11|Rom.11:11-12]], [[2-corinthians 5 19|2Co.5:19]], [[galatians 6 1|Gal.6:1]], [[ephesians 1 7|Eph.1:7 2:1, 5]], [[colossians 2 13|Col.2:13]].† SYN.: see: ἁμαρτία (AS)
παρα-ρρέω [in LXX: [[isaiah 44 4|Isa.44:4]] (יָבַל), [[proverbs 3 21|Pro.3:21]] * ;] to flow by, drift away, slip away: [[hebrews 2 1|Heb.2:1.]]† (AS)

παράσημος, -ον (σῆμα, a mark) [in LXX: 3Ma.2:29 * ;] 1. in cl., marked amiss, spurious, counterfeit. Later, 2. marked at the side, annotated (Plut.). 3. marked with a sign (LXX); as subst., a figure­head : [[acts 28 11|Act.28:11]] (see MM, xix).† (AS)

παρα-σκευάζω [in LXX: [[jeremiah 50 42|Jer.50:42]] (עָרַךְ), etc. ;] to prepare, make ready: absol. (sc. τ. δεῖπνον, etc.; of. Hdt., ix, 82, 2Ma.2:27), [[acts 10 10|Act.10:10]]; mid., to prepare, make preparations: [[1-corinthians 14 8|1Co.14:8]] (cf. Je, l.with); pass., [[2-corinthians 9 2|2Co.9:2-3.]]† (AS)

παρα-σκευή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX: [[exodus 35 24|Exo.35:24 39:42]] (עֲבֹדָה, with seel., ἀποσκ-, κατασκ-), Jdth.2:17 4:5, 1Ma.9:35 א, 2Ma.15:21 * ;] 1. preparation. 2. equipment (Jth, ll with). 3. In Jewish usage, the day of preparation for a Sabbath or a feast (= προσάββατον, which see) : [[matthew 27 62|Mat.27:62]], [[mark 15 42|Mrk.15:42]], [[luke 23 54|Luk.23:54]], [[john 19 31|Jhn.19:31]]; with genitive, τοῦ πάσχα, [[john 19 14|Jhn.19:14;]] τ. Ἰoυδαίων, [[john 19 42|Jhn.19:42]] (it is the name for Friday in MGr.).† (AS)
παρα-τείνω [in LXX: [[numbers 23 28|Num.23:28]] (שָׁקַף ni.), etc. ;] to extend, pro­long: τ. λόγον, [[acts 20 7|Act.20:7.]]† (AS)

παρα-τηρέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[psalms 37 12|Psa.37:12]] (זָמַם), [[psalms 130 8|Psa.130:8]] (שָׁמַר), Da TH [[daniel 6 11|Dan.6:11]] (12), Su 1:12,15,16* ;] 1. to watch closely, observe narrowly: so mid., τ. πύλας, [[acts 9 24|Act.9:24;]] with evil intent, [[mark 3 2|Mrk.3:2]], [[luke 20 20|Luk.20:20]] (absol., see Field, Notes, 74); so mid., [[luke 6 7|Luk.6:7 14:1]]. 2. to observe scrupulously (of days and seasons; cf. [[exodus 12 42|Exo.12:42]], Sm.): mid., [[galatians 4 10|Gal.4:10.]]† (AS)
παρα-τήρησις, -εως, ἡ [in Aq.: [[exodus 12 42|Exo.12:42]] (see: παρατηρέω) * ;] obser­vation: [[luke 17 20|Luk.17:20]] (Polyb., Plut., al.).† (AS)

παρα-τίθημι [in LXX chiefly for שׂוּם ;] I. Act., to place beside, set before, with accusative and dative: of food, [[mark 6 41|Mrk.6:41 8:6-7]], [[luke 9 16|Luk.9:16 11:6]]; τράπεζαν, [[acts 16 34|Act.16:34;]] pass. ptcp., [[luke 10 8|Luk.10:8]], [[1-corinthians 10 27|1Co.10:27]]; metaphorically, of teaching, παραβολήν, [[matthew 13 24|Mat.13:24, 31]]. II. Mid., 1. to have set before one (Hom., Thuc., Xen., al.). 2. to deposit with another, give in charge or commit to (Hdt., Xen., Polyb., al.) : with accusative and dative, [[luke 12 48|Luk.12:48 23:46]], [[acts 14 23|Act.14:23 20:32]], [[1-timothy 1 18|1Ti.1:18]], [[2-timothy 2 2|2Ti.2:2]], [[1-peter 4 19|1Pe.4:19]]. 3. to bring forward, quote as evidence: before ὅτι, [[acts 17 3|Act.17:3]] (see Page, in l).† (AS)
παρα-τυγχάνω to happen to be near or present: [[acts 17 17|Act.17:17.]]† (AS)

παρ-αυτίκα adv. (πάραυτα = παρ ̓ αὐτά, sc. τὰ πράγματα) [in LXX: [[psalms 70 3|Psa.70:3]], Tob.4:14 * ;] 1. immediately. 2. C. subst., to express brief duration (cf. ἡ π. λαμπρότης, Thuc., ii, 64), momentary, for a moment: [[2-corinthians 4 17|2Co.4:17.]]† (AS)

παρα-φέρω [in LXX: [[1-samuel 21 13|1Ki.21:13]] (14) (הָלַל hithpo.), and as seel. 2* ;] 1. to bring to, set before, esp. of food (Hdt., al.). 2. to take or carry away: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, [[mark 14 36|Mrk.14:36]], [[luke 22 42|Luk.22:42]]; pass., before ὑπό, Ju 12; metaphorically, pass., with dative, [[hebrews 13 9|Heb.13:9.]]† (AS)
παρα-φρονέω (ιαρά, φρήν), [in LXX: [[zechariah 7 11|Zec.7:11]] (סָרַר)* ;] to be beside oneself, be deranged: [[2-corinthians 11 23|2Co.11:23.]]† (AS)
παρα-φρονία, -ας, ἡ = cl. παραφροσύνη, madness: [[2-peter 2 16|2Pe.2:16.]]† (AS)
παρα-χειμάζω to winter at a place: before εἰς, [[acts 27 12|Act.27:12;]] ἐν, [[acts 28 11|Act.28:11;]] πρὸς ὑμᾶς, [[1-corinthians 16 6|1Co.16:6;]] ἐκεῖ, [[titus 3 12|Tit.3:12.]]† (AS)
παρα-χειμασία, -ας, ἡ (παρα-χειμάζω) a wintering: [[acts 27 12|Act.27:12]] (Polyb., al.).† (AS)

παραχρῆμα adv. (= παρὰ τὸ χρῆμα), [in LXX: [[numbers 6 9|Num.6:9 12:4]], [[isaiah 29 5|Isa.29:5 30:13]] (פִּתְאוֹם), etc. ;] on the spot, forthwith, instantly: [[matthew 21 19|Mat.21:19-20]], [[luke 1 64|Luk.1:64 4:39 5:25 8:44, 47 8:55 13:13 18:43 19:11 22:60]], [[acts 3 7|Act.3:7 5:10 12:23 13:11 16:26, 33]] (on the usage in Mt, Lk, see Dalman, Words, 28 f.).† (AS)
πάρδαλις, -εως, ἡ [in LXX for נָמֵר, [[song-of-solomon 4 8|Sng.4:8]], [[hosea 13 7|Hos.13:7]], [[isaiah 11 6|Isa.11:6]], al. ;] a panther, leopard: [[revelation 13 2|Rev.13:2.]]† (AS)

πάρ-ειμι [in LXX for בּוֹא, etc. ;] 1. to be by, at hand or present; (a) of persons: [[revelation 17 8|Rev.17:8;]] παρών (opposite to ἀπών), [[1-corinthians 5 3|1Co.5:3]], [[2-corinthians 10 2|2Co.10:2 10:11 13:2 13:10]]; before ἐπί with genitive, [[acts 24 19|Act.24:19;]] ἐνώπιον, [[acts 10 33|Act.10:33;]] ἐνθάδε, [[acts 17 6|Act.17:6;]] πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[acts 12 20|Act.12:20]], [[2-corinthians 11 8|2Co.11:8]], [[galatians 4 18|Gal.4:18, 20]]; (b) of things : of time, ὁ καιρός, [[john 7 6|Jhn.7:6;]] τ. παρόν, [[hebrews 12 11|Heb.12:11;]] ἡ ἀλήθεια, [[2-peter 1 12|2Pe.1:12;]] ταῦτα, [[2-peter 1 9|2Pe.1:9;]] τ. παρόντα, [[hebrews 13 5|Heb.13:5.]] 2. to have come or arrived (Hdt., Thuc., al.; see Field, Notes, 65) : [[luke 13 1|Luk.13:1]], [[john 11 28|Jhn.11:28]], [[acts 10 21|Act.10:21]]; before εἰς, [[colossians 1 6|Col.1:6;]] before ἐπί, with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 26 50|Mat.26:50]] (cf. συν-πάρειμι).† (AS)
παρ-εισ-άγω 1. to lead in by one's side, bring forward, introduce. 2. In late writers, to introduce or bring in secretly: [[2-peter 2 1|2Pe.2:1.]]† (AS)
παρ-είσ-ακτος, -ον (παρεισάγω), brought in secretly (as spies or traitors) : [[galatians 2 4|Gal.2:4.]]† (AS)
παρ-εισ-δύω (also -δύνω), to slip in secretly, steal in: παρεισεδύησαν (vulgar aor.; pass. for act., El., § 19, 2), Ju 4 (cf. also MM, xix).† (AS)
παρ-εισ-έρχομαι 1. to come in beside or by the way: [[romans 5 20|Rom.5:20.]] 2. to come in secretly, steal in: [[galatians 2 4|Gal.2:4.]]† (AS)
παρ-εισ-φέρω to bring in or supply besides: σπουδὴν π. (late Gk. for cl. σ. ποιεῖσθαι; cf. Deiss., BS, 361), [[2-peter 1 5|2Pe.1:5.]]† (AS)

παρ-εκτός = cl. παρέκ, -έξ, [in Aq.: [[deuteronomy 1 36|Deu.1:36;]] Al., [[leviticus 23 38|Lev.23:38]] * ;] 1. as adv., besides, in addition: τὰ π. (sc. γινόμενα), [[2-corinthians 11 28|2Co.11:28.]] 2. As prep. with genitive, except: [[matthew 5 32|Mat.5:32 19:9]] (WH, mg., R, mg.), [[acts 26 29|Act.26:29.]]† (AS)

παρ-εμ-βολή, -ῆς, ἡ (παρεμβάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for מַחֲנֶה ;] 1. an insertion, interpolation (Æschin.) 2. In the Macedonian dialect (Rutherford, NPhr., 473), as a military term; (a) an army in battle array: [[hebrews 11 34|Heb.11:34]] (cf. [[exodus 14 19|Exo.14:19-20]], [[judges 4 16|Jdg.4:16]], al.; frequently in Polyb.); (b) a camp ([[exodus 29 14|Exo.29:14]], al.) : [[hebrews 13 11|Heb.13:11, 13]] [[revelation 20 9|Rev.20:9]]; (with) barracks, soldiers' quarters: [[acts 21 34|Act.21:34, 37 22:24 23:10, 16 23:32 28:16]] (WH, txt., R, om.).† παρ-εμ-βάλλω, [in LXX frequently and chiefly for מַחֲנֶה ;] 1. to put in beside or between, interpose. 2. In late writers (Polyb., al., LXX) as technical military term; (a) of soldiers, to draw up in line (frequently in 1Ma.2:32, al.); (b) of siege works, to cast up: with accusative and dative, χάρακά σοι, [[luke 19 43|Luk.19:43.]]† (AS)
παρ-εν-οχλέω, -ῶ (cf. ἐνοχλέω), [in LXX for לָאָה hi. ([[micah 6 3|Mic.6:3]]), etc. ;] to annoy concerning a matter (παρά): with dative of person(s), [[acts 15 19|Act.15:19.]]† (AS)

παρ-επί-δημος, -ον (see: ἐπιδημέω), [in LXX: [[genesis 23 4|Gen.23:4]], [[psalms 39 12|Psa.39:12]] (תּוֹשָׁב)* ;] sojourning in a strange place; as subst., ὁ π., a sojourner: of Christians, [[1-peter 1 1|1Pe.1:1;]] ξένοι καὶ π., [[hebrews 11 13|Heb.11:13;]] πάροικοι καὶ π., [[1-peter 2 11|1Pe.2:11]] (see Deiss., BS, 149).† (AS)

παρ-ἐρχομαι [in LXX chiefly for עָבַר ;] 1. to pass, pass by; (a) of persons: absol., [[luke 18 37|Luk.18:37;]] with accusative of person(s), [[mark 6 48|Mrk.6:48;]] with accusative lot., [[acts 16 8|Act.16:8;]] before διά, with genitive, [[matthew 8 28|Mat.8:28;]] (b) of things : τ. ποτήριον, [[matthew 26 39|Mat.26:39]] (ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ), [[matthew 26 42|Mat.26:42;]] of time, [[matthew 14 15|Mat.14:15]], [[mark 14 35|Mrk.14:35]], [[acts 27 9|Act.27:9]], [[1-peter 4 3|1Pe.4:3]]. Metaphorical, (a) to pass away, perish: [[matthew 5 18|Mat.5:18 24:34-35]] [[mark 13 30|Mrk.13:30-31]], [[luke 16 17|Luk.16:17 21:32-33]], [[2-corinthians 5 17|2Co.5:17]], [[james 1 10|Jas.1:10]], [[2-peter 3 10|2Pe.3:10]]; (b) to pass by, neglect, disregard: with accusative of thing(s), [[luke 11 42|Luk.11:42 15:29]]. 2. to come to, arrive: [[luke 12 37|Luk.12:37 17:7]], [[acts 24 7|Act.24:7]], R, mg. (cf. ἀντι-παρέρχομαι).† SYN.: παραβαίνω (AS)
πάρεσις, -εως, ἡ (παρίημι), 1. a letting go, dismissal. 2. prætermission, passing by (of debt or sin) : [[romans 3 25|Rom.3:25]]† SYN.: ἄφεσις, q.v (AS)

παρ-έχω [in LXX: [[psalms 30 7|Psa.30:7]] (עָמַד hi.), etc. ;] I. Active voice., 1. to furnish, provide, supply; with ref. to incorporeal things, to afford, show, give, cause: with accusative, [[acts 22 2|Act.22:2]], [[1-timothy 1 4|1Ti.1:4]]; with accusative and dative, [[matthew 26 10|Mat.26:10]], [[mark 14 6|Mrk.14:6]], [[luke 11 7|Luk.11:7 18:5]], [[acts 16 16|Act.16:16 17:31 28:2]], [[galatians 6 17|Gal.6:17]], [[1-timothy 6 17|1Ti.6:17]]. 2. to present, offer: with accusative and dative, [[luke 6 29|Luk.6:29;]] with prop. reflex. and accusative pred., to show or present oneself (see infr., and cf. B1., § 55, 1). II. Middle voice., 1. to supply, furnish or display of one's own part: with accusative and dative, [[luke 7 4|Luk.7:4]], [[acts 19 24|Act.19:24]], [[colossians 4 1|Col.4:1]]. 2. In late writers, with prop. reflex. and accusative pred. (= act. ut supr.), to show or present oneself (Xen., FlJ, al.; cf. M, Pr., 248; Deiss., BS, 254) : [[titus 2 7|Tit.2:7.]]† (AS)
παρηγορία, -ας, ἡ (παρηγορέω, to address, exhort, console) [in LXX: 4Ma.5:12 4Mac 6:1 * ;] 1. an address, exhortation (LXX, ll. with). 2. comfort, consolation: [[colossians 4 11|Col.4:11.]]† (AS)
παρθενία, -ας, ἡ (παρθένος), [in LXX: [[jeremiah 3 4|Jer.3:4]] (נָעוּר), Sir.15:2 42:10, 4Ma.18:8 * ;] virginity: [[luke 2 36|Luk.2:36.]]† (AS)

παρθένος, -ου, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for בְּתוּלָה, [[exodus 22 16|Exo.22:16]] (15), [[job 31 1|Job.31:1]], [[isaiah 23 4|Isa.23:4]], al.; also for נַעַר, נַעֲרָה, [[genesis 24 14|Gen.24:14, 16 24:55 34:3]], and for עַלְמָה, [[genesis 24 43|Gen.24:43]], [[isaiah 7 14|Isa.7:14]] ;] a maiden, virgin: [[matthew 1 23|Mat.1:23]] (LXX) [[matthew 25 1|Mat.25:1, 7 25:11]] [[luke 1 27|Luk.1:27]], [[acts 21 9|Act.21:9]], [[1-corinthians 7 25|1Co.7:25]] ff, [[2-corinthians 11 2|2Co.11:2;]] masc., of chaste persons (CIG, 8784 b) : [[revelation 14 4|Rev.14:4.]]† (AS)
Πάρθος, -ου, ὁ a Parthian: [[acts 2 9|Act.2:9.]]† (AS)

παρ-ίημι [in LXX: [[jeremiah 4 31|Jer.4:31]] (פָּרַשׂ pi.), etc. ;] 1. to pass by or over, let alone, disregard: [[luke 11 42|Luk.11:42.]] 2. to relax, loosen; pass., to be relaxed, weakened, exhausted: παρειμένας χεῖρας, [[hebrews 12 12|Heb.12:12]] (LXX ἀνειμ-).† (AS)

παρ-ίστημι [in LXX for עָמַד, etc. ;] I. Transitive verb. in present tense., imperfect., future tense., 1 aorist.; 1. to place beside, present, provide: with accusative, [[acts 9 41|Act.9:41 23:24]], [[2-corinthians 4 14|2Co.4:14]], [[colossians 1 28|Col.1:28]]; with accusative and dative, [[matthew 26 53|Mat.26:53]], [[luke 2 22|Luk.2:22]], [[acts 1 3|Act.1:3 23:33]], [[1-corinthians 8 8|1Co.8:8]]; before accusative pred., [[romans 6 13|Rom.6:13, 16]] (late pres., παριστάνετε), [[romans 6 19|Rom.6:19 12:1]], [[2-corinthians 11 2|2Co.11:2]], [[ephesians 5 27|Eph.5:27]], [[colossians 1 22|Col.1:22]], [[2-timothy 2 15|2Ti.2:15]]. 2. to present to the mind (cl.) : by argument, to prove (Xen., FlJ, al.), with accusative, [[acts 24 13|Act.24:13.]] II. Intransitive. in perfect., pluperfect., 2 aorist.; 1. to stand by or beside one : with dative of person(s), [[acts 1 10|Act.1:10 9:39 23:2 27:23]]; ptcp., [[mark 14 47|Mrk.14:47, 69-70 15:35, 39]] [[john 18 22|Jhn.18:22 19:26]]. 2. to appear: with nom. pred., before ἐνώπιον, [[acts 4 10|Act.4:10;]] with dative of person(s), [[acts 27 24|Act.27:24;]] so fut. mid. (of. LS, see word, B, ii, 2), [[romans 14 10|Rom.14:10.]] 3. to be at hand, be present, have come: [[acts 4 26|Act.4:26]] (LXX); of servants in attendance, ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, [[luke 1 19|Luk.1:19;]] absol., οἱ παρεστῶτες, [[luke 19 24|Luk.19:24;]] before αὐτῷ, [[acts 23 2|Act.23:2]], 4; of time, [[mark 4 29|Mrk.4:29]] 4. to stand by for help or defence (Hom., Dem., Xen., al.): with dative of person(s), [[romans 16 2|Rom.16:2]], [[2-timothy 4 17|2Ti.4:17]].† (AS)
Παρμενᾶς, ᾶ, ὁ Parmenas: [[acts 6 5|Act.6:5.]]† (AS)
πάρ-οδος, -ου, ἡ [in LXX: [[genesis 38 14|Gen.38:14]] (דֶּרֶךְ), etc. ;] a passing or passage: ἐν π., in passing, [[1-corinthians 16 7|1Co.16:7.]]† (AS)

παρ-οικέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for גּוּר, also for יָשַׁב, שָׁכַן ] in cl., to dwell beside (with accusative), among (with dative) or near by (absol.). In late writers, to dwell in a place as a πάροικος (which see) or stranger: [[luke 24 18|Luk.24:18]], [[hebrews 11 9|Heb.11:9]].† (AS)

παρ-οικία, -ας, ἡ (παροικέω, which see), [in LXX: [[esther 8 35|Est.8:35]] (גּוֹלָה), [[psalms 34 4|Psa.34:4 55:15 119:54 120:5]], [[lamentations 2 22|La 2:22]] (מָגוֹר; and cogn. forms), [[habakkuk 3 16|Hab.3:16]], I [[esther 5 7|Est.5:7]], Jdth.5:9, Wis.19:10, Sir prol. Sir.1:26 16:8 41:5 44:6, 3Ma.6:36 3Mac 7:19 * ;] a sojourning: [[acts 13 17|Act.13:17]], [[1-peter 1 17|1Pe.1:17]].† (AS)

άρ-οικος, -ον [in LXX chiefly for גֵּר, תּוֹשָׁב ;] 1. in cl. Attic, dwelling near, neighbouring; as subst., a neighbour. 2. In late writers (LXX, Philo) and in Iuser. (Deiss., BS, 227 f.; Kennedy, Sources, 102), foreign, alien; as subst., an alien, a sojourner: [[acts 7 6|Act.7:6]] (LXX), [[acts 7 29|Act.7:29;]] metapb., ξένοι καὶ π. (opposite to συμπολίτης), [[ephesians 2 19|Eph.2:19;]] π. καὶ παρεπιδήμους (which see), [[1-peter 2 11|1Pe.2:11]] (see Lft. on Clem. Rom., 1 Co., § 1).† (AS)

παροιμία, -ας, ἡ (πάροιμος, by the way), [in LXX. Pr title [[proverbs 1 1|Pro.1:1 25:1]], (מָשַׁל) subscr., Sir.6:35 8:8 18:29 39:3 47:17 * ;] 1. a wayside saying (Hesych.; see LS, see word), a byword, maxim, proverb: [[2-peter 2 22|2Pe.2:22.]] 2. In NT, of figurative discourse (as מָשַׁל, [[isaiah 14 4|Isa.14:4]], al.), a parable, allegory: [[john 10 6|Jhn.10:6 16:25, 29]] (see Abbott, Essays, 82 ff.).† SYN.: παραβολή, q.v (AS)
πάρ-οινος, -ον = cl., παροινικός (παρά, οἶνος), given to wine, drunken: [[1-timothy 3 3|1Ti.3:3]], [[titus 1 7|Tit.1:7]].† (AS)
παρ-οίχομαι to have passed by; of time, to be gone by: ἐν τ. παρῳχημέναις γενεαῖς, [[acts 14 16|Act.14:16.]]† (AS)
παρ-ομοιάζω to be like: with dative, [[matthew 23 27|Mat.23:27.]]† (AS)
παρ-όμοιος, -ον (also -η (Hdt.), -α (Arist.), -ον), much like, like: [[mark 7 13|Mrk.7:13.]]† (AS)

παρ-οξύνω [in LXX for נָאַץ, קָצַף, רָגַז, etc. ;] 1. primarily, but never so in cl., to sharpen (μάχαιραν, [[deuteronomy 32 41|Deu.32:41]], שָׁנַן). 2. Metaphorical, as always in cl., (a) to spur on, stimulate (Arist., Xen., al.); (b) to provoke, rouse to anger ([[deuteronomy 9 7|Deu.9:7, 18]], [[psalms 106 29|Psa.106:29]], al.) : pass., [[acts 17 16|Act.17:16]], [[1-corinthians 13 5|1Co.13:5]].† (AS)

παροξυσμός, -οῦ, ὁ (παροξύνω), [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 29 28|Deu.29:28]], [[jeremiah 32 37|Jer.32:37]] (קֶצֶף)* ;] 1. stimulation, provocation: π. ἀγάπης, [[hebrews 10 14|Heb.10:14.]] 2. irritation: [[acts 15 39|Act.15:39.]]† (AS)
παρ-οργίζω [in LXX chiefly for כַּעַס hi. ;] (in cl., passive only), to provoke to anger: [[romans 10 19|Rom.10:19]] (LXX), [[ephesians 6 4|Eph.6:4.]]† (AS)

παρ-οργισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (παροργίζω), [in LXX: 3Ki.15:30, [[2-kings 23 26|4Ki.23:26]] (כַּעַס); 4Ki.19:3, [[nehemiah 9 18|Neh.9:18, 26]] (נְאָצָה); [[jeremiah 21 5|Jer.21:5]] A (קֶצֶף) * ;] irritation ("distinguished from ὀργή as implying a less permanent state"; ICC, Eph., 140; and see Tr., Syn., § xxxvii) : [[ephesians 4 26|Eph.4:26.]]† (AS)
παρ-οτρύνω to urge on, stir up: with accusative of person(s), [[acts 13 50|Act.13:50]] (find., Hipp., and late writers).† (AS)

παρ-ουσία, -ας, ἡ [in LXX: [[nehemiah 2 6|Neh.2:6]] A, Jdth.10:18, 2Ma.8:12 2Mac 15:21, 3Ma.3:17 * ;] 1. usually in cl., a being present, presence: [[1-corinthians 16 17|1Co.16:17]], [[2-corinthians 10 10|2Co.10:10]]; opposite to ἀπουσία, [[philippians 2 12|Php.2:12]] (cf. 2Ma.15:21). 2. a coming, arrival, advent (Soph., Eur., Thuc., al., see LS, see word; so Jth, l.with, 2Ma.8:12) : [[2-corinthians 7 6|2Co.7:6-7]], [[philippians 1 26|Php.1:26]], [[2-thessalonians 2 9|2Th.2:9]]; in late writers (see M, Th., 145 ff.; MM, xix; LAE, 372 ff.) as technical term for the visit of a king; hence, in NT, specif. of the Advent or Parousia of Christ : [[matthew 24 3|Mat.24:3, 27 24:37, 39]], [[1-corinthians 15 23|1Co.15:23]], [[1-thessalonians 2 19|1Th.2:19 3:13 4:15 5:23]], [[2-thessalonians 2 1|2Th.2:1 2:8]], [[james 5 7|Jas.5:7-8]], [[2-peter 1 16|2Pe.1:16 3:4 3:12]], [[1-john 2 28|1Jn.2:28]].† (AS)

παρ-οψίς, -ίδος, ἡ (παρά, ὄψον; see: ὀψάριον), 1. a side-dish of dainties (Xen., al.). 2. In Comic poets and late prose, the dish itself on which the dainties are served: [[matthew 23 25|Mat.23:25-26]] (In this sense it is condemned by the Atticists; see Rutherford, NPhr., 265 f.)† (AS)

παρρησία, -ας, ἡ (πᾶς + ῥῆσις, speech) [in LXX; [[leviticus 26 13|Lev.26:13]] (μετὰ π., קוֺמְמִיּוּת קוֹמְמִיּוּת), [[proverbs 1 20|Pro.1:20 10:10]], Wis.5:1, al. ;] 1. freedom of speech, plainness, openness, freedom in speaking (Eur., Plat., al.) : [[acts 4 13|Act.4:13]], [[2-corinthians 3 12|2Co.3:12]]; παρρησίᾳ, adverbially, freely, openly, plainly, [[mark 8 32|Mrk.8:32]], [[john 7 13|Jhn.7:13, 26 10:24 11:14 16:29 18:20]]; opposite to ἐν παροιμίαις, [[john 16 25|Jhn.16:25;]] ἐν π., [[ephesians 6 19|Eph.6:19;]] μετὰ π., [[acts 2 29|Act.2:29 4:29, 31 28:31]] 2. In LXX (1Ma.4:18, Wis.5:1, al.), FlJ, and NT, also (from the absence of fear which accompanies freedom of speech), confidence, boldness: [[2-corinthians 7 4|2Co.7:4]], [[philippians 1 20|Php.1:20]], [[1-timothy 3 13|1Ti.3:13]]; ἔχειν π., [[ephesians 3 12|Eph.3:12]], Phm 8, [[hebrews 3 6|Heb.3:6 10:19, 35]], [[1-john 2 28|1Jn.2:28]] [[john 3 21|Jn 3:21]] [[john 4 17|Jn 4:17]] [[john 5 14|Jn 5:14]]; μετὰ π., He 416; ἐν π., [[colossians 2 15|Col.2:15;]] id. (as בפרהסיא in Rabbinic lit.; see Westc., Jo., i, 262), in public, [[john 7 4|Jhn.7:4]] and (without ἐν) [[john 11 54|Jhn.11:54.]]† (AS)

παρρησιάζομαι (παρρησία), [in LXX: [[job 22 26|Job.22:26]] (עָנַג hithp.), [[psalms 12 5|Psa.12:5 94:1]], [[proverbs 20 9|Pro.20:9]], [[song-of-solomon 8 10|Sng.8:10]], Sir.6:11 * ;] to speak freely or boldly, be bold in speech: [[acts 9 27|Act.9:27-28 13:46 14:3 18:26 19:8 26:26]], [[ephesians 6 20|Eph.6:20]], [[1-thessalonians 2 2|1Th.2:2]].† (AS)

πᾶς, πᾶσα, πᾶν, genitive, παντός, πάσης, παντός, [in LXX chiefly for כֹּל ;] all, every. I. As adj., 1. with subst. anarth., all, every, of every kind: [[matthew 3 10|Mat.3:10 4:23]], [[mark 9 49|Mrk.9:49]], [[luke 4 37|Luk.4:37]], [[john 2 1|Jhn.2:1]]o, [[acts 27 20|Act.27:20]], [[romans 7 8|Rom.7:8]], [[revelation 18 17|Rev.18:17]], al. mult.; pl., all, [[acts 22 15|Act.22:15]], [[romans 5 12|Rom.5:12]], [[hebrews 1 6|Heb.1:6]], al.; of the highest degree, π. ἐξουσία (προθυμία, χαρά), [[matthew 28 18|Mat.28:18]], [[acts 17 11|Act.17:11]], [[philippians 2 29|Phi 2:29]], al.; also the whole (though in this sense more frequently with art.), [[matthew 2 3|Mat.2:3]], [[acts 2 36|Act.2:36]], [[romans 11 26|Rom.11:26]]. 2. C. art. (before the art., after the noun, or, denoting totality, between the art. and noun), all, whole: [[matthew 8 32|Mat.8:32 13:2]], [[mark 5 33|Mrk.5:33]], [[luke 1 10|Luk.1:10]], [[acts 7 14|Act.7:14]], [[romans 3 19|Rom.3:19]], [[galatians 5 14|Gal.5:14]], [[ephesians 4 16|Eph.4:16]], al.; pl., [[matthew 2 4|Mat.2:4]], [[mark 4 13|Mrk.4:13]], [[romans 1 5|Rom.1:5]], al. II. As pron., 1. masc. and fem., every one: [[mark 9 49|Mrk.9:49]], [[luke 16 16|Luk.16:16]], [[hebrews 2 9|Heb.2:9]]; before rel. pron., [[matthew 7 24|Mat.7:24]], [[acts 2 21|Act.2:21]], [[galatians 3 10|Gal.3:10]], al.; with ptcp. (anarth.), [[matthew 13 19|Mat.13:19]], [[luke 11 4|Luk.11:4]]; with ptcp. (with art.), [[matthew 5 22|Mat.5:22]], [[mark 7 8|Mrk.7:8]], [[luke 6 47|Luk.6:47]], [[john 3 8|Jhn.3:8]], [[romans 1 16|Rom.1:16]], al.; pl., πάντες, absol., all, all men, [[matthew 10 22|Mat.10:22]], [[mark 13 13|Mrk.13:13]], [[luke 20 38|Luk.20:38]], [[john 1 7|Jhn.1:7 3:26]], [[1-corinthians 8 1|1Co.8:1]], al.; οἱ π. (collectively, as a definite whole), [[romans 11 32|Rom.11:32]], [[1-corinthians 1 17|1Co.1:17]], [[ephesians 4 13|Eph.4:13]], al.; π. οἱ (ὅσοι), [[matthew 4 24|Mat.4:24]], [[mark 1 32|Mrk.1:32]], [[luke 4 40|Luk.4:40]], al. 2. Neut., (a) sing., πᾶν, everything, all: πᾶν τό, with ptcp., [[1-corinthians 10 25|1Co.10:25, 27]], [[ephesians 5 13|Eph.5:13]], [[1-john 2 16|1Jn.2:16 5:4]] (sc. ὄν); πᾶν ὅ, [[john 17 2|Jhn.17:2]], [[romans 14 23|Rom.14:23]]; collectively, of persons (Westc., in l.), [[john 6 37|Jhn.6:37, 39]]; with prep., in adverbial phrases, διὰ παντός, always, [[matthew 18 10|Mat.18:10]], al.; ἐν παντί, in everything, in every way, [[2-corinthians 4 8|2Co.4:8]], [[philippians 4 6|Phi 4:6]], al.; (b) pl., πάτνα, all things: absol., [[john 1 3|Jhn.1:3]], [[1-corinthians 2 10|1Co.2:10]], [[hebrews 2 8|Heb.2:8]], al.; of certain specified things, [[mark 4 34|Mrk.4:34]], [[luke 1 3|Luk.1:3]], [[romans 8 28|Rom.8:28]], [[1-thessalonians 5 21|1Th.5:21]], al.; accusative, πάντα, adverbially, wholly, in all things, in all respects, [[acts 20 35|Act.20:35]], [[1-corinthians 9 25|1Co.9:25]], al.; with art., τὰ π., all things (a totality, as distinct from anarth. πάντα, all things severally; cf. Westc, Eph., 186f.), absol.: [[romans 11 36|Rom.11:36]], [[1-corinthians 8 6|1Co.8:6]], [[ephesians 3 9|Eph.3:9]], [[hebrews 1 3|Heb.1:3]], al.; relatively, [[mark 4 11|Mrk.4:11]], [[acts 17 25|Act.17:25]], [[romans 8 32|Rom.8:32]], al.; πάντα, with ptcp., [[matthew 18 31|Mat.18:31]], al.; πάντα ταῦτα (ταῦτα π.), [[matthew 6 32|Mat.6:32, 33]], al.; πάντα, with prep, in adverbial phrases, πρὸ πάντων, above all things, [[james 5 12|Jas.5:12]], [[1-peter 4 8|1Pe.4:8]]; ἐν π́, in all things, in all ways, [[1-timothy 3 11|1Ti.3:11]], [[1-peter 4 11|1Pe.4:11]], al.; κατὰ πάντα, in all respects, [[acts 17 22|Act.17:22]], al. 3. C. neg., πᾶς οὐ (μή) = οὐδείς, see: οὐ and μή, and cf. M, Pr., 245f. (AS)

πάσχα, τό indecl. (Aram. טַּסְחָא), [in LXX for פֶּסַח ;] 1. the festival of the Passover: [[matthew 26 2|Mat.26:2]], [[mark 14 1|Mrk.14:1]], [[luke 22 1|Luk.22:1]], [[john 2 13|Jhn.2:13, 23 6:4 11:55 12:1 18:39 19:14]], [[acts 12 4|Act.12:4]], [[hebrews 11 28|Heb.11:28]]; .ἡ ἐορτὴ τοῦ π., [[luke 2 41|Luk.2:41]], [[john 13 1|Jhn.13:1]]. 2. By meton., (a) the paschal supper: ἑτοιμάζειν τὸ π., [[matthew 26 19|Mat.26:19]], [[mark 14 16|Mrk.14:16]], [[luke 22 8|Luk.22:8, 13]]; ποιεῖν τό π., [[matthew 26 18|Mat.26:18;]] (b) the pasohal lamb: θύειν τό π. ([[exodus 12 21|Exo.12:21]]), [[mark 14 12|Mrk.14:12]], [[luke 22 7|Luk.22:7]]; of Christ, [[1-corinthians 5 7|1Co.5:7;]] φαγεῖν τὸ π. (lamb or supper), [[matthew 26 17|Mat.26:17]], [[mark 14 12|Mrk.14:12, 14]], [[luke 22 11|Luk.22:11, 15]], [[john 18 28|Jhn.18:28]] (cf. [[2-chronicles 30 17|2Ch.30:17]]).† (AS)

πάσχω [in LXX: [[amos 6 6|Amo.6:6]] (חָלָה ni.), Wis.12:27, Sir.38:16, al. ;] to suffer, be acted on, as opposite to acting, often limited by a word expressive of good or evil; (a) of misfortunes (most frequently without any limiting word) : absol., [[luke 22 15|Luk.22:15 24:46]], [[acts 1 3|Act.1:3 3:18 17:3]], [[1-corinthians 12 26|1Co.12:26]], [[hebrews 2 18|Heb.2:18 9:26 13:12]], [[1-peter 2 19|1Pe.2:19-20 2:23 3:17 4:15 4:19]]; before ὑπό, with genitive, [[matthew 17 12|Mat.17:12;]] ὑπέρ, [[acts 9 16|Act.9:16]], [[philippians 1 20|Php.1:20]], [[2-thessalonians 1 5|2Th.1:5]], [[1-peter 2 21|1Pe.2:21]]; with dative ref., [[1-peter 4 1|1Pe.4:1;]] περί, with genitive (before ὑπέρ), [[1-peter 3 18|1Pe.3:18;]] διά, with accusative, [[1-peter 3 14|1Pe.3:14;]] ὀλίγον (a little while), [[1-peter 5 10|1Pe.5:10;]] with accusative, [[matthew 27 19|Mat.27:19]], [[mark 9 12|Mrk.9:12]], [[luke 13 2|Luk.13:2 24:26]], [[acts 28 5|Act.28:5]], [[2-timothy 1 12|2Ti.1:12]], [[hebrews 5 8|Heb.5:8]], [[revelation 2 10|Rev.2:10]]; παθήματα, [[2-corinthians 1 6|2Co.1:6;]] ταῦτα, [[galatians 3 4|Gal.3:4]] (EV; cf. Lft., in l, but see infr.); accusative before ἀπό, [[matthew 16 21|Mat.16:21]], [[luke 9 22|Luk.9:22 17:25]]; ὑπό, [[mark 5 26|Mrk.5:26]], [[1-thessalonians 2 14|1Th.2:14]]; (b) of pleasant experiences (but always with qualifying word, εὖ or accusative of thing(s)) : [[galatians 3 4|Gal.3:4]] (cf. Grimm-Thayer, see word; Interp. Corn., in l, but see supr.) (cf. προ-, συν-πάσχω).† (AS)
Πάταρα, -ων, τὰ Patara, a maritime city of Lycia: [[acts 21 1|Act.21:1.]]† (AS)

πατάσσω [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for נָכָה hi., also for נָגַף, etc. ;] 1. in Hom., intrans., to beat (of the heart). 2. Trans. = πλήσσω, to strike, smite: absol., ἐν μαχαίρᾳ, [[luke 22 49|Luk.22:49;]] with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 26 51|Mat.26:51]], [[luke 22 50|Luk.22:50;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[acts 12 7|Act.12:7;]] of a deadly blow, [[matthew 26 31|Mat.26:31]], [[mark 14 27|Mrk.14:27]], [[acts 7 24|Act.7:24]]. Metaphorical, of disease: [[acts 12 23|Act.12:23]], [[revelation 11 6|Rev.11:6 19:15]].† (AS)

πατέω, -ῶ [in LXX for דָּרַךְ, etc. ;] 1. intrans., to tread, walk: before ἐπάνω ὄφεων κ.τ.λ. (figuratively), [[luke 10 19|Luk.10:19]] (cf. [[psalms 91 13|Psa.91:13]]). 2. Trans., to tread on, trample: τ. ληνόν, [[revelation 14 20|Rev.14:20 19:15]] (cf. [[judges 9 27|Jdg.9:27]], [[lamentations 1 15|La 1:15]], al.); of the desecration of Jerusalem by its enemies, [[luke 21 24|Luk.21:24]], [[revelation 11 2|Rev.11:2]] (cf. κατα-, περι-, ἐν-περι-πατέω).† (AS)

πατήρ, πατρός, -τρί, τέρα, [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for אָב ;] a father; 1. prop., (a) of the male parent: [[matthew 2 22|Mat.2:22]], [[luke 1 17|Luk.1:17]], [[john 4 53|Jhn.4:53]]; anarth., [[hebrews 12 7|Heb.12:7]] (M, Pr., 82 f.); pl., of both parents (cl.), [[hebrews 11 23|Heb.11:23;]] οἱ π. τ. σαρκός, [[hebrews 12 9|Heb.12:9;]] (b) of a forefather or ancestor (in cl. usually in pl.; Hom., al.): [[matthew 3 9|Mat.3:9]], [[luke 1 73|Luk.1:73]], [[john 8 39|Jhn.8:39]], al.; pl., [[matthew 23 30|Mat.23:30, 32]] [[luke 6 23|Luk.6:23, 26]] [[john 4 20|Jhn.4:20]], [[1-corinthians 10 1|1Co.10:1]], al. 2. Metaphorical, (a) of an author, originator, or archetype (= αἴτιος, ἀρχηγός, etc.; Pind., Plat., al.): [[john 8 41|Jhn.8:41-44]], [[romans 4 11|Rom.4:11, 12]] 16. (b) as a title of respect or honour, used of seniors, teachers and others in a position of responsible authority ([[judges 17 10|Jdg.17:10]], [[2-samuel 2 12|2Ki.2:12]], [[proverbs 1 8|Pro.1:8]], al.): [[matthew 23 9|Mat.23:9]] [[acts 7 2|Act.7:2 22:1]], [[1-john 2 13|1Jn.2:13]]. 3. Of God (as in cl. of Zeus) as Father; (a) of created things: τ. φώτων, [[james 1 17|Jas.1:17;]] (b) of all sentient beings: [[ephesians 3 14|Eph.3:14, 15]] [[hebrews 12 9|Heb.12:9]]; (with) of men, esp. those in covenant relation with Him (freq in OT and later Jewish lit.; see Dalman, Words, 184ff.): [[matthew 6 4|Mat.6:4]], [[luke 6 36|Luk.6:36]], [[john 4 21|Jhn.4:21]], [[james 3 9|Jas.3:9]], al.; ὁ π. ὁ ἐν (τ.) οὐρανοῖς, [[matthew 5 16|Mat.5:16]], [[mark 11 25|Mrk.11:25]]; ὁ π. ὁ οὐράνιος, [[matthew 6 14|Mat.6:14 15:13]]; esp. in the Epp., of Christians: [[romans 8 15|Rom.8:15]], [[2-corinthians 6 18|2Co.6:18]], [[galatians 4 6|Gal.4:6]], [[ephesians 2 18|Eph.2:18 4:6]], [[1-john 2 1|1Jn.2:1;]] with genitive qual., τ. οἰκτιρμῶν, [[2-corinthians 1 3|2Co.1:3;]] τ. δοξῆς, [[ephesians 1 17|Eph.1:17;]] (d) of Christ (Dalman, Words, 190 ff.); (α) by our Lord himself: ὁ π., [[matthew 11 25|Mat.11:25-27]], [[luke 10 2|Luk.10:2, 22]] [[john 5 20|Jhn.5:20-23]], al.; ὁ π. μου, [[matthew 11 27|Mat.11:27]], al.; ὁ ἐν τ. οὐρανοῖς, [[matthew 7 11|Mat.7:11]], al.; ὁ οὐράνιος, [[matthew 15 13|Mat.15:13;]] vocat., [[john 11 41|Jhn.11:41 12:27, 28 17:1, 5, 11, 20, 25]] (cf. Abbott, JG., 96 f.); (β) by Apostles: [[john 1 14|Jhn.1:14]] (anarth.; see M, Pr., l.with), [[romans 15 6|Rom.15:6]], [[2-corinthians 1 3|2Co.1:3 11:31]], [[ephesians 1 3|Eph.1:3]], [[colossians 1 3|Col.1:3]], [[hebrews 1 5|Heb.1:5]], [[1-peter 1 3|1Pe.1:3]], [[revelation 1 6|Rev.1:6]] (cf. Westc., Epp. Jo., 27-34). (AS)
Πάτμος, -ου, ἡ Patmos, an island in the Ægean Sea: [[revelation 1 9|Rev.1:9.]]† (AS)

πατρολῴας (-αλῴας, Rec.; in cl. -αλοίας, see Bl., § 3, 3; 6, 2, and cf. μητρολῴας), -ου, ὁ (πατήρ + ἀλοιάω, to smite), (a) a parricide: [[1-timothy 1 9|1Ti.1:9]] (Av, R, txt.); (b) a smiter of his father : ib. (R, mg.).† (AS)

πατριά, -ᾶς, ἡ (πατήρ), [in LXX chiefly for אָב, [[exodus 6 14|Exo.6:14]], al., also for מִשְׁפָּחָה, [[exodus 6 15|Exo.6:15]], [[2-kings 14 7|4Ki.14:7]], [[psalms 22 27|Psa.22:27]], al. ;] 1. lineage, ancestry (Hdt.). 2. = πάτρα (more common in cl.), a family or tribe (so sometimes in Hdt., in LXX of related people, in a sense narrower than φυλή and wider than οἶκος; see [[exodus 12 3|Exo.12:3]], [[numbers 32 28|Num.32:28]]): [[luke 2 4|Luk.2:4]]; in a wider sense ([[1-chronicles 16 28|1Ch.16:28]], [[psalms 22 27|Psa.22:27]]), [[acts 3 25|Act.3:25]]" (LXX) [[ephesians 3 15|Eph.3:15.]]† (AS)

πατριάρχης, -ου, ὁ (πατριά, ἄρχω), [in LXX: [[1-chronicles 24 31|1Ch.24:31]] (אָב), [[2-chronicles 19 8|2Ch.19:8 26:12]] (אָב רֹאשׁ), [[1-chronicles 27 12|1Ch.27:12]] (שַׂר), [[2-chronicles 23 20|2Ch.23:20]] (מֵאָה שַׂר), 4Ma.7:19 4Mac 16:25 * ;] a patriarch: [[acts 2 29|Act.2:29 7:8-9]], [[hebrews 7 4|Heb.7:4]].† (AS)
πατρικίς, -ή, -όν (πατήρ), [in LXX for אָב, [[genesis 50 8|Gen.50:8]], al. ;] paternal, ancestral: [[galatians 1 14|Gal.1:14.]]† (AS)

πατρίς, -ίδος, ἡ (πατήρ), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹלֶדֶת ;] prop. poët. fern. of πάτριος, of one's fathers; as subst., ἡ π. = πάτρα, fatherland, country, home, native place: [[acts 18 27|Act.18:27]], WH, mg., [[hebrews 11 14|Heb.11:14;]] of one's own town, [[matthew 13 54|Mat.13:54, 57]], [[mark 6 1|Mrk.6:1]], 4, [[luke 4 23|Luk.4:23-24]], [[john 4 44|Jhn.4:44]].† (AS)
Πατρόβας, -ᾶ, ὁ Patrobas: [[romans 16 14|Rom.16:14.]]† (AS)
πατρο-παρά-δοτος, -ον (πατήρ, παραδίδωμι), handed down from one's fathers, inherited: [[1-peter 1 18|1Pe.1:18]] (Diod., al.).† (AS)

πατρῷος, -α, -ον (πατήρ), [in LXX: [[proverbs 27 10|Pro.27:10]] (אָב), [[esther 7 5|Est.7:5]], 2 -4Ma.12:1-19 * ;] of one's fathers, received from one's fathers: [[acts 22 3|Act.22:3 24:14 28:17]].† (AS)

Παῦλος, -ου, ὁ (Lat. Paulus), 1. Sergius Paulus: [[acts 13 7|Act.13:7.]] 2. the Apostle Paul (cf. Σαῦλος): [[acts 13 9|Act.13:9]], and frequently throughout Ac., [[romans 1 1|Rom.1:1]], [[1-corinthians 1 1|1Co.1:1]], al., [[2-peter 3 15|2Pe.3:15]]. (AS)

Παῦλος, -ου, ὁ (Lat. Paulus), 1. Sergius Paulus: [[acts 13 7|Act.13:7.]] 2. the Apostle Paul (cf. Σαῦλος): [[acts 13 9|Act.13:9]], and frequently throughout Ac., [[romans 1 1|Rom.1:1]], [[1-corinthians 1 1|1Co.1:1]], al., [[2-peter 3 15|2Pe.3:15]]. (AS)

παύω [in LXX for כָּלָה pi., etc. ;] to make to cease, restrain, hinder: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό [[1-peter 3 10|1Pe.3:10]] (LXX). Mid., to cease, leave off: [[luke 8 24|Luk.8:24 11:1]], [[acts 20 1|Act.20:1]], [[1-corinthians 13 8|1Co.13:8]]; with ptcp., [[luke 5 4|Luk.5:4]], [[acts 5 42|Act.5:42 6:13 13:10 20:31 21:32]], [[ephesians 1 16|Eph.1:16]], [[colossians 1 9|Col.1:9]], [[hebrews 10 2|Heb.10:2]]; with genitive, ἀμαρτίας, [[1-peter 4 1|1Pe.4:1]] (WH, mg., R, txt.); with dative, ib. (WH, txt., R, mg.).† (AS)
Πάφος, -ου, ἡ Paphos, a city in Cyprus: [[acts 13 6|Act.13:6, 13]] † (AS)

παχύνω (παχύς, thick) [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 32 15|Deu.32:15]], [[isaiah 6 10|Isa.6:10]] (שָׁמֵן), al. ;] to thicken, fatten; pass., to grow fat. Metaphorical, to make dull or stupid (τ. ψυχάς, Rut.); pass., to wax gross: ἡ καρδία„ [[matthew 13 15|Mat.13:15]], [[acts 28 27|Act.28:27]]" (LXX) .† (AS)
πέδη, -ης, ἡ (πέζα, the instep), [in LXX for נְחֹשֶׁת, etc. ;] a fetter: [[mark 5 4|Mrk.5:4]], [[luke 8 29|Luk.8:29]].† (AS)
πεδινός, -ή, -όν (πεδίον, a plain), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁפֵלָה (ἡ π.) ;] level, plain: [[luke 6 17|Luk.6:17.]]† (AS)
πεζεύω (πεζός) to travel on foot or by land: [[acts 20 13|Act.20:13.]]† (AS)
